title: Verifying Rolle's Theorem for a Cubic
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Verify the hypotheses of Rolle's Theorem for f(x) = x^3 - 4x on [-2, 2], and find all numbers c that satisfy the conclusion.

steps.title: Check Hypotheses
steps.mathExpression: f \text{ is continuous on } [-2, 2], \; f \text{ is differentiable on } (-2, 2); \quad f(-2) = -8 + 8 = 0, \; f(2) = 8 - 8 = 0
steps.explanation: Polynomials are everywhere continuous and differentiable, and f(-2) = f(2) = 0.
steps.why: All 3 hypotheses of Rolle's Theorem are satisfied.
